# browserBible fixtures

Real pages, generated by browserBible-3's own generator
(https://github.com/digitalbiblesociety/browserbible-3, MIT) from the sample
texts it ships with, so the reader is tested against the files as that tool
writes them:

- `heb_wlc/` — Westminster Leningrad Codex (public domain) with OpenScriptures
  Hebrew Bible lemmas and morphology (CC BY 4.0): Genesis 1.
- `eng_kjv2006/` — King James Version 2006 with Strong's numbers (public
  domain): Genesis 1, John 3, and the first entries of one bucket of its `indexlemma` search index, cut short.
- `eng_web/` — World English Bible (public domain): Psalm 23 (a title and
  poetry), Matthew 5 (footnotes and words of Jesus).
